C-SOURCE-REVIEW-COVERAGE.IntentSummary: Implement the approved full-review operation inventory, independent verification and bilingual reporting. Verify the candidate locally before submitting a pull request and update the installed skill from the checked main revision.

T-001.Title: Validate versioned full-run inventory and section dispositions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Validate coverage of the internal catalogue, operation identity, ownership, omissions and pinned evidence before publication. Support historic and bounded profiles.

T-002.Title: Render operation coverage in summaries and both reports

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Show traced, skipped and inapplicable operations with reasons, including carried source provenance and incomplete coverage, independently of numeric scores.

T-003.Title: Route discovery through operation families and verify unsampled paths

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Document recon, inspector and independent verifier responsibilities, scope, on-disk contracts and limits. Preserve the private paired evaluation separately.

T-004.Title: Integrate, review and verify the distributable skill

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Version metadata agrees, compatibility fixtures and positive and negative coverage checks pass, and an independent review and publication gate cover the outgoing candidate.
